haaijer1999.title: Modeling conjoint choice experiments with the probit model

green1992_classic.title: Citation classic: Conjoint analysis in consumer research: issues and outlook

overview_sentence: Conjoint analysis decomposes an overall preference into a part-worth for each attribute level.

self_checks.title: Best profile
self_checks.prompt: Brand A has part-worth 0, brand B has 2, the low price has 3, and the high price has 0. Which profile has utility 5?
self_checks.answer: Brand B at the low price, because 2 + 3 = 5.
